takeaways: Dr. Tea: both reels are already on the site, but the 24 Edited Pictures are unused. Orchid-sip n8 (5) should become the work/dr-tea cover and the header of the 480k-views blog post, and drink hero n11 plus couple shot n22 should go in the case-study gallery; the Mike and Product stories only repeat the on-site Emily template. SXP: the unused 4K 'Website No Logo' intro (4) should lead work/sxp and service:content-development, but it still has burned-in titles and the logo end card, so it is not clean enough for the hero loop; the founder talking-head (3) is supporting material, and the phone-shot May and June folders are too weak to use. Chad Isaiah Photography is the strongest new-client material: both campaigns' final carousels and single-image ads (4) are enough for a new case-study page and fit service:digital-advertising, with Campaign B slide 3 as the cover and the mockup board (Other Versions n7) as the overview once it is redone with the final gray slides. Castle Rock Tax has only flat letterhead strips with an '(Address Line)' placeholder, so it needs a paper mockup before it can appear on design-branding, and it cannot support a case study alone.
